description: This PHP source file defines a class 'FormatWithLanguage' that implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface. It provides functionality to retrieve a language name based on an ID, utilizing a language service. The class is part of the 'OrangeHRM\Maintenance\AccessStrategy\FormatValue' namespace and interacts with the Language and LanguageService classes.

classes.name: FormatWithLanguage
classes.description: A class that formats values into language names using a language service.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Retrieves the language name corresponding to a given language ID.

methods.name: getLanguageService
methods.description: Provides an instance of LanguageService, creating it if it does not already exist.
